title: hypericum humifusum subsp. liottardii
intro: Hypericum humifusum subsp. liottardii, commonly known as Creeping St. John's Wort, is a low-growing, spreading, and mat-forming perennial plant native to the Iberian Peninsula. It is a member of the St. John's Wort family (Hypericaceae) and has been used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. Creeping St. John's Wort is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of anxiety and depression, and its ability to promote wound healing and reduce inflammation. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, which have been shown to have therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
